name: Trove (National Library of Australia)

steps: Open https://trove.nla.gov.au, go to Profile → API and get a key.
Put TROVE_KEY=<key> in .env in the project root.

notes: Often only a thumbnail; the viewer links to the partner page.
Harvard and Trove have no usable licence data.
Built from the public API documentation; not yet tested live (no key yet).
